import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='Cmq7HEs'].copy()

dims = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
base = acc[acc.date<='10/19/25'].groupby(dims)['unblended_cost'].sum()
anom = acc[acc.date=='10/20/25'].groupby(dims)['unblended_cost'].sum()
comp = pd.concat([base,anom],axis=1).fillna(0)
comp.columns=['base','cost_20']
comp['delta']=comp.cost_20-comp.base
print(comp.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(10))

# Look at the top 2 resources in detail
top = comp.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(3).index
for idx in top:
    print(idx)
    sub = acc[acc[dims].apply(tuple,axis=1)==idx]
    print(sub.groupby('date')[['price','num_instances','unblended_cost']].sum())
    print()
